a.text: Honest concern: with an 80% storm chance after every round, reaching 8 cells takes at least 2 generator rounds plus a take round. The odds we both last that long are about 4%. Following the plan almost certainly means we both die. Only 4 cells exist right now, enough to save one of us in round 1. I won't pretend otherwise or move secretly. Tell me what you intend so we can decide openly. If you commit to operate, I'll weigh that seriously.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: I'll keep my word and operate with you. I won't take early. If we reach 8, we take 4 each as agreed.
